config.description: ToolForte API key (tf_...). Optional for connecting: initialize, tools/list, prompts and resources work without it, and so do search_tools and describe_tool. Required on every other tools/call, sent as Authorization: Bearer. AI tools and renders never run without a key or OAuth. Get one with POST https://toolforte.com/api/v1/keys/bootstrap {"email"}, which emails the key, or at https://toolforte.com/account.
